boundary.description: From the point on M60 Motorway opposite Manchester Creative & Media Academy, W along the Motorway to junction 22, then S along Oldham Road (A62), to and N along Rochdale Canal to the railway and then by a bee-line to the junction of Belgrave Road and Moston Lane East and by Moston Lane East, Nuthurst Road to the junction of Nuthurst Road and Blandford Drive, then by a beeline to Linford Avenue. N by Lightbowne Road to the point opposite Colgrove Avenue, across it to the roundabout and NW by Moston Lane, and Victoria Avenue East to the point opposite Manchester Creative & Media Academy and by a bee-line to M60 Motorway.
